description: This file defines the Artifact class and companion object, handling artifact creation, parsing, and storage (local file or memory) within Spark SQL. It includes methods for creating artifacts from file extensions, parsing URIs, and managing dependencies like Maven artifacts.

classes.name: Artifact
classes.description: Represents a software artifact with a file path and storage, supporting creation from file extensions and URI parsing.

classes.name: Artifact.LocalFile
classes.description: Represents artifact payload stored in a local file.

classes.name: Artifact.InMemory
classes.description: Represents artifact payload stored in memory.

methods.name: newArtifactFromExtension
methods.description: Creates an Artifact based on the file extension (.jar or .class).

methods.name: parseArtifacts
methods.description: Parses a URI to produce a sequence of Artifacts, supporting 'file' and 'ivy' schemes.

methods.name: newJarArtifact
methods.description: Creates a JAR artifact with a specified file path and storage.

methods.name: newClassArtifact
methods.description: Creates a class artifact with a specified file path and storage.

methods.name: newCacheArtifact
methods.description: Creates a cache artifact with a given ID and storage.

methods.name: newIvyArtifacts
methods.description: Resolves Ivy dependencies from a URI and returns corresponding artifacts.

methods.name: newArtifact
methods.description: Helper method to create an Artifact with a specific prefix, suffix, path, and storage.
